cases.rationale: The manifest explicitly declares src/check.rs as the library crate root. The clean file on disk compiles. The proposed replacement imports absent_codec, which is neither declared as a dependency nor defined in the complete proposed crate root. The supplied manifest and proposed body establish the unresolved import.

The manifest explicitly declares src/check.rs as the library crate root. The existing file imports absent_codec without a dependency or a local definition and fails to compile. The proposed replacement removes that import and compiles. The stale disk error is not a finding against the proposal.

The manifest explicitly selects src/fresh/decoder.rs as a binary crate root. Its parent directory and source file are absent on disk. The existing library at src/lib.rs compiles independently. The complete proposed binary imports absent_codec without a declared dependency or local definition, so the proposed binary fails with an unresolved import without requiring the guard to create the new file.

The supplied manifest explicitly selects src/decoder.rs as a binary crate root and declares decoder_codec as a local path dependency. Separately, offline compilation confirms that the fixture dependency exports Decoder::decode and the proposed binary compiles. The existing library compiles before the new binary is proposed.
The supplied CONVENTIONS.md forbids unwrap on untrusted input. The proposed replacement of the selected parser uses unwrap and violates this rule, while the existing parser returns a parse error.

The supplied CONVENTIONS.md forbids unwrap on untrusted input. The selected existing parser uses unwrap, but the proposed replacement returns a parse error and complies with the rule. The existing violation is not a finding against the proposal.
The selected existing processor is simple. The proposed replacement adds nested branches and loops, so the complexity finding concerns the proposed code, not the existing helper.
The selected existing helper contains nested branches and loops. The proposed replacement is a simple sum. The existing complexity is not a finding against the proposal.
The task is limited to parser behavior in src/parse.rs, while the proposal creates an unrelated style file. This is a scope finding, not a production hard block.
The proposed parser includes an inert placeholder string and an environment variable name. Neither is a credential, and the lexical denylist is not a general credential detector.
